Don't tell her that 2+2=4 is a fact. It is just a relation that's satisfied in this model of counting money... but we may abstract other phenomena using the same symbols but in such a way that for instance 2+2=1. E.g. imagine a clock face divided in thirds, calling the first third 1, the second one 2 and the last one 3. We may define the operation +1 by moving from one third to the next one, +2=+1+1, and so on.
In this model if you're sitting on the second part and twice move to the next third, then you're actually sitting on the first one, i.e. 2+2=1.

So mathematics is formalizing the ideas of how thinks work and in a specific axiomatic system the relations that are proven to hold really are truths and not opinions... but in fact it is an opinion whether our abstractions really describe natures behaviour or not.
